name: Tile Conveyor
description: Gaps open between the tiles of the first clip over a track that winds through every tile; the tiles glide along it like a train, the first clip's tiles leaving at the bottom right while the second clip's enter at the bottom left and wind through the frame until they settle in place. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: order
params.description: Size of the track: 2 to the power of order tiles along each side

params.name: gap
params.description: Width of the gaps between the tiles, as a part of a tile

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the bevel and of the shadow the tiles cast on the track

params.name: tray
params.description: Color of the tray under the tiles
